hero.title: Hot dogs in Cambridge, served with history
hero.subtitle: Welcome to The Hot Sausage Company. Serving hot dogs from our traditional Victorian-style barrow on Fitzroy Street since 1986. Stop by for lunch, a shopping break or a bite between lectures.

certifications.title: Good food. Friendly faces. Peace of mind.
certifications.subtitle: From lunch on Fitzroy Street to catering for your celebration, we take food hygiene and safe preparation seriously. Have a question about ingredients or allergens? Please ask our team before ordering.

moments.title: Moments from the barrow
moments.subtitle: From Fitzroy Street lunch stops to wedding celebrations, we've been bringing people together over hot dogs since 1986. Take a look at the faces, places and happy memories that make our story.

eventBooking.title: A little Cambridge character for your event
eventBooking.subtitle: Bring our traditional hot dog barrow to your wedding, party or corporate event. Enjoy a taste of Cambridge street food, friendly service and something your guests will remember.

schedule.title: Weddings & celebrations
schedule.description: From wedding evening food to birthday parties, give your guests a hot dog and a reason to gather.

service.title: Service to suit your day
service.description: Tell us your plans and we'll help arrange serving times around your celebration.

venue.title: Your venue, our barrow
venue.description: Planning an event in Cambridge or the surrounding area? Let's talk about your location and the space you have available.

eventBooking.ctaNote: Pick a date · pay securely with Stripe

locateUs.title: Visit us on Fitzroy Street
locateUs.subtitle: Tucked just off the high street, two minutes from the Grand Arcade.
